summary.problem: The update_topic tool (and other auto-executing background tools) is included in the tool confirmation queue size calculation, causing the UI to display misleading counts (e.g. '1 of 2') when only one tool requires approval.
summary.root_cause: getConfirmingToolState in packages/cli/src/ui/utils/confirmingTool.ts calculates total as allPendingTools.length and index based on headIndexInFullList. Since allPendingTools includes all tool calls in pendingHistoryItems regardless of status, non-confirming background tools like update_topic inflate the queue count.
summary.context: Background tools like update_topic auto-execute without requiring user confirmation and never enter AwaitingApproval status. The confirmation queue counter should only reflect tools that actually require user approval.

steps: Update getConfirmingToolState in packages/cli/src/ui/utils/confirmingTool.ts to calculate total using confirmingTools.length instead of allPendingTools.length.
Update index calculation in getConfirmingToolState to reflect the 1-based index within confirmingTools rather than allPendingTools.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: When pendingHistoryItems contains both a background tool like update_topic (status Executing/Success) and a tool requiring approval (status AwaitingApproval), getConfirmingToolState returns total equal to 1 and index equal to 1, excluding background tools from the confirmation queue count.
verification_steps: Create unit tests in packages/cli/src/ui/utils/confirmingTool.test.ts for getConfirmingToolState.
Assert that when only 1 tool is AwaitingApproval and other background tools (e.g., update_topic with Executing status) are present in pendingHistoryItems, total is 1.
Assert that when multiple tools are AwaitingApproval, total equals the count of AwaitingApproval tools and index is correctly calculated.
Assert that when no tools are AwaitingApproval, getConfirmingToolState returns null.

github_metadata.title: [BUG] update_topic tool inflates confirmation queue count
